name: Build a manga app that connected

messages.content: Build a manga app that connected to the website which the user can search the app and get the manga to read on the app

I have built and connected the **MangaVerse** application to live manga catalog services and the MangaDex At-Home network, allowing you to discover, search, and read manga directly inside the app.

You can preview the live app here:
👉 **[View the Manga App](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/e61667ac-7dd9-4c18-a967-c3a1d5a47dc4/b1a62c46a65ae50033dbea23/)**

---

### Key Features Built

1. **Live Manga Catalog & Search**:
   - **Real-Time Search Bar**: Debounced global search across tens of thousands of manga, manhwa, and webtoons with keyboard shortcut (`/`).
   - **Rich Filter Controls**: Filter by genre/tags (*Action, Romance, Fantasy, Isekai, Sci-Fi, Mystery, Comedy, etc.*), publication status (*Ongoing, Completed, Hiatus*), demographic (*Shounen, Seinen, Shoujo, Josei*), and sort order (*Most Popular, Top Rated, Latest Updated, A-Z*).
   - **Spotlight Hero Showcase**: Interactive carousel highlighting featured manga with synopses, ratings, and instant "Read Now" buttons.
   - **Surprise Me (Random Manga)**: One-click button to discover random titles from the catalog.

2. **Built-In Reader Engine**:
   - **Webtoon Mode**: Continuous vertical stream with smooth scrolling, lazy loading, and automatic page-progress tracking.
   - **Single Page Mode**: Page flip with screen tap hotspots, touch swipe gestures on mobile, and keyboard arrow navigation (`←` / `→`).
   - **Reading Direction**: Toggle between Left-to-Right (LTR) and Right-to-Left (RTL traditional manga).
   - **Bandwidth Saver**: Switch between High Definition (`HD`) and `Data Saver` modes.
   - **Chapter Drawer & Controls**: Jump to any chapter from within the reader, scrub pages with the slider, or toggle fullscreen.
   - **Chapter Completion Screen**: Displays completion status and one-click navigation to the next chapter.

3. **Manga Details & Multi-Language Chapters**:
   - High-resolution covers with blurred backdrop glow, community ratings (out of 10), follower counts, author/artist metadata, and full synopsis.
   - Dynamic language tabs (*English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, All*) tailored to each manga's available translations.
   - Chapter search and order toggle (Ascending `1 ➔ Last` or Descending `Last ➔ 1`).
   - Clear indicators distinguishing chapters hosted for built-in in-app reading from external publisher links.

4. **Library, Bookmarks & Reading Progress**:
   - **Continue Reading Shelf**: Automatically resumes reading from your exact chapter and page.
   - **Favorites & Bookmarks**: Save manga to your local library.
   - **Theme Customization**: Switch between **Cyber Dark** (default), **Midnight AMOLED**, and **Clean Light** modes in settings.
